crossRefs.note: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”
As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that…
“Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them…
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what…
brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

translations.web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
